prose: Salesforce is acquiring Rune Technologies, a defense-tech startup making AI military logistics software, for $375 million in a combination of cash and stock, according to two sources familiar with the matter cited by Resilience Media; Rune previously raised $30M from a16z and others. The cached page returned unrelated content (a different article from the same site), so the deal details come from the feed's report of the scoop.
highlights: Salesforce acquires Rune Technologies for $375M in cash and stock, per sources
Rune builds AI military logistics software and raised $30M from a16z and others
basis: Techmeme summary of the Resilience Media scoop; cached page content did not match the story
